name: Cliffbound
source:
When the choice of living for yourself or living for others is on the line, what wolf will you choose?

Cliffbound explores the life of Prince Elm. An Omega Prince being married off to end a war he had no part in starting. When his Father and Papa disagree on the outcome of his future its up to Elm to either sink or swim. Which will you do?

[From [url=https://tamacitris.itch.io/cliffbound]Itch.io[/url]]
